content: Delivered: Replaced faidx_nseq, faidx_iseq, faidx_seq_len64 with pure Rust cached lookups. Reader now pre-builds a Vec<String> of sequence names and a HashMap<String, u64> of sequence lengths at construction time (calling C FFI once). n_seqs(), seq_name(), fetch_seq_len() are now fully safe Rust with zero FFI calls. 5 differential tests verify equivalence with C oracle. All 234 tests pass, clippy clean.
